snippet.title: Spires of Morosith | Trailer 2
snippet.description:
The magical homeland of Arborglen is under siege. Summon defensive towers to combat the Grainwraith and control their path. Harvest resources and shape the battlefield with your Gatherers. Reignite the Spires and bring peace back to Arborglen.

Spires of Morosith is a traditional mazing tower defense where the towers you summon influence the path the enemies take towards their goal, the Spires. You also control Gatherers which can remove resource nodes from the map creating new pathways for enemies to flow through, or space for your towers to be summoned. The push-and-pull dynamic between the two provide opportunity for thoughtful strategies to turn into chaotic moments.

Features:
- Freeform tower placement. Shape enemy routes, no fixed paths.
- Command Gatherers to harvest and clear resources in real time.
- Multiple tower upgrade paths that provide strategic options.
- Epic boss battles that break the mold.
- Dynamic modifiers: wind speed, reactive critters, and more.
- Risk-reward Ruin expeditions that unlock powerful towers and buildings.
- Optional challenge modes to master.
- Lighthearted art style with bright colors and soft shapes for a relaxed but engaging pace.

FULL RELEASE COMING SOON! SUBSCRIBE TO STAY TUNED FOR THE RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT!
